version: DuckDB 1.4 (LTS); the page reads "This page is for DuckDB 1.4 (LTS)."
line: last_value(expr[ ORDER BY ordering][ IGNORE NULLS])
note: Description on the page: "Returns expr evaluated at the row that is the last row (among rows with a non-null value of expr if IGNORE NULLS is set) of the window frame."

version: Spark 4.2.0; the page title reads "Window Functions - Spark 4.2.0 Documentation"
placement: after the closing parenthesis, before OVER
note: The page also shows "Note: Only LAG | LEAD | NTH_VALUE | FIRST_VALUE | LAST_VALUE can be used with IGNORE NULLS." and the example line "LAST_VALUE(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER w last_value".

version: Trino 484; the page title ends "Trino 484 Documentation"
note: The Value functions section states: "By default, null values are respected. If IGNORE NULLS is specified, all rows where x is null are excluded from the calculation." Neither this page nor https://trino.io/docs/current/sql/select.html shows where IGNORE NULLS is written; CI runs the after-the-parenthesis form on Trino 483.

line: Cause: IGNORE NULLS can now be used only with the value functions first_value, last_value, nth_value, lead, and lag. This change was made to conform to the ANSI SQL specification.
note: No Athena page found that gives a LAST_VALUE syntax line. This page links "value functions" to https://trino.io/docs/current/functions/window.html#value-functions, the Trino 484 page above, and does not state which Trino version engine version 3 follows.
